Empowering Minds, Shaping Futures

Welcome to Lather High School, Karnal A distinguished institution offering education from UKG to Class 12. With a legacy of academic excellence, strong values, and holistic development, we are committed to nurturing confident, responsible, and well-rounded individuals prepared to shape a brighter future.
School Establish year 1985
At Lather High School, Karnal, we believe that education is about more than academic achievement. It is about nurturing curiosity, confidence, discipline, and strong values in every student.
We strive to provide a supportive environment where students can learn, grow, explore their talents, and develop into well-rounded individuals.
Our goal is to prepare every child for a bright future with knowledge, character, and a sense of responsibility towards society.
Experienced Faculty
Dedicated and experienced teachers who guide students with care, encouragement, and individual attention.
Academic Excellence
A strong focus on academic fundamentals, disciplined learning, and helping every student achieve their full potential.
Values & Discipline
We believe in building strong character through discipline, respect, responsibility, and good values.
Sports & Activities
Encouraging students to participate in sports and co-curricular activities to develop confidence, teamwork, and a healthy spirit.
Supportive Environment
A caring and positive school environment where students feel encouraged to learn, express themselves, and grow.
Holistic Development
We focus on the overall development of every child — nurturing knowledge, creativity, confidence, character, and social responsibility.
Morning Assembly & Values
Each day begins with a meaningful morning assembly that encourages discipline, gratitude, positive thinking, and a strong sense of unity among our students. It sets a positive tone for the day ahead.
Academic Dedication & Learning

We encourage students to develop strong study habits, curiosity, and a genuine interest in learning. With the guidance of our teachers, students are encouraged to think independently, work together, and build confidence in their abilities.
# Together, We Can Shape More Futures

Education has the power to inspire lives and build a better tomorrow. Your support can help Lather High School provide greater opportunities for students, strengthen learning resources, and continue nurturing future generations.
Every contribution, big or small, can make a meaningful difference in a student’s journey.
